article_framing_rejections.headline: Indian River County approves expansion of Westside Racquet Club in Vero Beach

lead_independence.headline: Indian River County approves expansion of Westside Racquet Club in Vero Beach
lead_independence.lead: The Indian River County Commission approved the special exception use and Phase 1 site plan Aug. 4 for the renovation and expansion of the existing Westside Racquet Club. The 6.89-acre property is located east of 43rd Avenue Southwest, north of 6th Lane Southwest and south of Fifth Place Southwest. The Planning Zoning Commission previously heard the same requests on June 11, voting unanimously to recommend approval but adding a special condition of approval due to concerns about potential noise pollution and light infiltration onto adjacent property owners.
